column12: background resistivity and noise level: calibrates every other line
strongest magnetic anomaly, dense and magnetic: possible active serpentinisation front (H2 source)
shallow magnetic body with a dense and magnetic core: H2 source candidate
deep magnetic body (top ~700 m) and its faults: source at depth and pathways
shallow magnetic body in the east: serpentinite or magnetite-rich mafic rock
low-density body at the coast: reservoir and seal side of the H2 system
deep dense block (top ~1.1 km): AMT only, fluid paths into it
